plan.name: Skip Python work with failed prerequisites
plan.summary: Complete step 3 of parent #794 in one plumbing change: schedule an exhaustive invocation one size larger only after its own successful, complete execution and passing transition, exhaustive-state and attempted-step conformance at the ratified bounds, retain eligible siblings, and omit the larger TLC run when none qualifies. Before acquiring or running Nagini, use the prepared proof input and requalified evidence to check every already knowable qualification prerequisite, including tested support for its assumed contracts, no disqualifying unaccounted input, and the existing recorded-call contract checks; preserve all same-declaration conformance routes and D-0416's same-session, same-source calls on accepted and declared-refused attempts, accepting any qualifying route without requiring a verifier verdict in advance or blocking on unrelated failures or unused contracts. Add Skipped []string fields, encoded as optional skipped reason lists, to PythonApplicationLarger and PythonApplicationProof records, retaining the invocation or proof-input identity, leaving skipped larger results non-required and unsuccessful and skipped proofs unrun and unchecked with no verified functions, command, image or verifier output; JSON, Markdown, requalification and fingerprints must preserve these distinctions and the original gate failure, while actual larger disagreements and verifier failures retain their existing behavior. This intentionally replaces the named tests' expectations that Nagini verifies proofs already blocked by conformance, assumed-contract support, missing observed calls or recorded caller-contract failures, while preserving preflight and missing-contract refusals, independent evidence, all-success behavior, and the existing timeout and cancellation rules. Update docs/python.md and the affected SPEC.md bullets for this refinement of D-0199, D-0260, D-0416 and D-0431, citing [#849's ratified plan](.invariant/plans/issue-849.json); the README's existing overview and Python-page link remain accurate, this plan records the scheduling and receipt decisions, and any additional decision or one-way door belongs to the merger under AGENTS.md.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationGateSkipsLarger849
tests.says: Only successful, complete base explorations with passing transitions, states and attempted steps run larger; mixed and all-skipped runs retain reasons and independent work, all-success runs remain unchanged, and an eligible larger disagreement still fails.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationGateSkipsProof849
tests.says: Nagini invocation counts follow each proof's known prerequisites: failed assumed support or conformance blocks it, missing contracts remain refused, and unused failed contracts, alternate passing conformance and eligible sibling proofs do not suppress valid work.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationGateObservedPrerequisites849
tests.says: Recorded refusal-decision calls qualify without selecting that function for exploration, even beside an unrelated failure; absent, accepted-only, stale-source or unsupported calls block Nagini only when no other route qualifies, and known caller-contract failures remain failures without running Nagini.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationSkipReceipts849
tests.says: Actual skipped work is explicit in JSON and Markdown, preserves the original failure and independent evidence, grants no proof or larger-bound assurance even after optimistic status edits, survives reattribution and JSON round trips, and binds its reasons and input identities into the fingerprint.
